Name: Four Seasons Sam Portrait and Sprite Overhaul
Author: SILVERFLAME4217
Description:
安裝：
1. 請先下載[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿解壓縮檔案後丟進去MOD資料夾
2.下載本體檔Four Seasons Sam Portrait and Sprite Overhaul解壓縮檔案後丟進去MOD資料夾中即可。
3. 兩個模組安裝後和NPC對話時請按"P"鍵轉換成高清肖像。

Installation:
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿, then extract the archive and place the folder into your Mods directory.
2. Download Four Seasons Sam Portrait and Sprite Overhaul, extract the archive, and place the folder into your Mods directory.
3. After installing both modules, press the “P” key when talking to NPCs to switch to high-resolution portraits.

-新增山姆四季頭像美化肖像(肖像作者: 陸離)
/Added enhanced four-season portraits for Sam. (Portrait artwork by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Mmabc623?gameId=1303]Mmabc623[/url])
